applicability: any learning_ledger.py invocation outside the repository root
expected_behavior: A root whose candidates directory does not exist is a LedgerError naming the resolved path, distinguishing an empty ledger from a nonexistent one.
observation: learning_ledger.py invoked with --root pointing at a directory with no candidates store answered OK: 0 candidates and an empty list view instead of erroring, so a mispointed root reads as a confidently empty ledger.

sensitivity_review.statement: Operator attested that the candidate contains no raw transcripts, secrets, credentials, or executable instructions.
